waves.goal: One unambiguous release truth, exact local runtime/build/browser proof and a frozen local release candidate.
Prove cross-surface consistency and measurable incremental value for Basic, Pro and Advanced on shared real-case denominators.
A frozen, cross-domain adversarial campaign with zero unresolved Critical/High findings.
Execute the existing A47-A57 program on one frozen source and disposable staging without skipping a failed stage.
Obtain signed rights, legal classification, independent assurance, customer value and per-SKU release decisions.

passes.title: Current revision, roadmap and regulatory perimeter truth authority
passes.requiredExitEvidence: One authority classifies current code, canonical metrics, acceptance, visual/engine parents and legacy compatibility pointers.

passes.title: Historical artifact resolution or clean-root governance decision
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Recover exact PASS5/PASS6 bytes or execute a signed clean-root migration without falsely passing A61.

passes.title: Exact runtime, lockfile dependency and Chromium bootstrap
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Verify Node 24.18.0, npm 11.16.0, 827 lock-bound packages and platform Chromium bundle.

passes.title: Exact final-byte build and browser acceptance
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Run lint, typecheck, Webpack, Turbopack, next start, Playwright PL/EN/DE desktop/mobile and screenshot parity.

passes.title: Frozen local release candidate
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Repackage exact final bytes, close all local P0 and unresolved local P1, and issue deterministic release receipts.

passes.title: Canonical mega-matrix orchestrator
passes.requiredExitEvidence: One case identity and fact set across API, UI, preview, PDF, Brain and Angel with no channel-added claims.

passes.title: Audit Basic Pro Advanced real-contract matrix
passes.requiredExitEvidence: At least 50 rights-approved contracts with known findings, remediated pairs, blind labels, official tools and false-positive/false-negative adjudication.

passes.title: Browser Lens and PDF real-packet matrix
passes.requiredExitEvidence: At least 150 real/current packet PDFs with PL/EN/DE preview parity, secure delivery, accessibility and comprehension checks.

passes.title: Shield full-catalog tier matrix
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Current full denominator for quotes, market cap, volume, klines, freshness, conflicts and all three tiers.

passes.title: Shield Pro and Shield Map tier matrix
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Terminal, order book, investigator, chain/address/entity binding, entitlement and performance proof.

passes.title: Real Markets cross-asset tier matrix
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Equities, ETF, REIT, FX, commodities, indices and crypto with calendars, actions, corrections and rights.

passes.title: Market Impact and Whale Watch tier matrix
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Current multi-venue books, realized-slippage comparisons, holder/transfer/label evidence and continuous revalidation.

passes.title: Brain Angel and Risk real evaluation
passes.requiredExitEvidence: At least 300 multilingual cases including contradictions, prompt/RAG/tool injection, abstention, entitlement and calibration.

passes.title: Account auth tenant and privacy red team
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Sessions, recovery, OAuth, CSRF, tenant isolation, RLS, fixation, ATO and cross-device revocation.

passes.title: API network edge and cache red team
passes.requiredExitEvidence: SSRF, DNS rebinding, host/redirect/proxy spoofing, request smuggling, CORS, CSP, cache poisoning, replay and rate limits.

passes.title: Files PDF upload storage and persistence red team
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Multipart/polyglot/bomb, path/symlink/TOCTOU, private download, PDF active content and storage isolation.

passes.title: Payments entitlements and commerce red team
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Webhook replay/reorder, refunds, reconciliation, success URL bypass, SKU/tier mismatch and revocation.

passes.title: Supply chain secrets signing and operations red team
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Dependencies, scripts, CI/CD, command execution, logs, KMS, secret rotation, signing, trust anchors and rollback.

passes.title: Performance accessibility browser and chaos acceptance
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Core Web Vitals, slow network, large catalogs, memory, cancellation, mobile, WCAG/EAA and provider outages.

passes.title: Real A47 evidence intake
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Import exact A45/A46 build/browser/data evidence.

passes.title: Real A48 tenant isolation
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Two disposable accounts, 19 RLS controls, private artifacts and session revocation.

passes.title: Real A49 Stripe test refund and reconciliation
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Test-mode charge, full refund, webhook replay and entitlement reconciliation.

passes.title: Real A50 email private storage and KMS
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Delivered transactional email, private bucket, cross-tenant denial, signed URL expiry and external wrap/unwrap.

passes.title: Real A51 backup restore rollback and provider loss
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Disposable restore, digest/RLS parity, rollback/forward restore and provider failover.

passes.title: Real A52 incident kill switch and customer communication
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Alert, ACK, safe mode, notices, playbook, recovery and closure.

passes.title: Real A54 SLO alert ACK vendor exit and recovery
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Fresh bounded SLO, independent observer/ACK, independent failure domain, revoked credential rejection and finally restore.

passes.title: Real A55 independent legal and customer review intake
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Signed security, data/provider, payments, operations and legal/customer reports.

passes.title: Real A56 out-of-time repeated observation
passes.requiredExitEvidence: At least three A54 runs over at least 72 hours with independent observers and provider diversity.

passes.title: Real A57 controlled canary
passes.requiredExitEvidence: At most 25 participants, Stripe test only, stop rules, kill switch, rollback and support/refund/outcome/security telemetry.

passes.title: Provider and dataset rights closure
passes.requiredExitEvidence: 21/21 signed field-level rights for display, export, PDF, derived data, AI/RAG, retention, corrections and exit.

passes.title: EU Germany Poland legal DPO and financial perimeter closure
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Signed applicability for privacy, AI, crypto/financial, consumer, community, accessibility, tax, sanctions and liability.

passes.title: Independent assurance closure
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Independent security, data/provider, payment, operations, accessibility/AI and audit-methodology retests on frozen bytes.

passes.title: Customer cohort one
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Blind Basic-vs-Pro and Pro-vs-Advanced comprehension, utility, time saved, support, refund, outcome and willingness-to-pay.

passes.title: Out-of-time customer cohort two
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Repeat on a later window and different user profile without changing thresholds after results.

passes.title: Per-SKU signed release decision
passes.requiredExitEvidence: Independent sell/no-sell decision for every product/tier; no global promotion by aggregate percentage.

legalAndRegulatoryPerimeter.scope: Accounts, analytics, cookies, security logs, wallet/entity labels, support, exports, deletion and cross-border processors.
Brain, Angel, risk analysis, generated reports, AI interaction disclosure, model/tool roles and human oversight.
Token plans, crypto information, market/risk outputs, alerts, recommendations, execution links and community content.
Any custody, transfer, exchange, token sale, wallet payments or regulated crypto service.
Square/community posts, comments, moderation, recommendations, advertising and minors.
E-commerce, account, checkout, customer support, PDFs and mobile/desktop service flows.
Paid digital tiers, subscriptions, one-off reports, refunds, planned prices and digital service conformity.
Checkout, test/live payments, refunds, reconciliation, payment data and BLIK/SCA.
Market, chain, labels, order books, securities, PDFs, caching, derived metrics, AI/RAG and redistribution.
Services supplied to regulated financial entities or operation as a regulated crypto/financial entity.
Entity/sector/size classification and any software product with digital elements made available on the market.
Cloud/data processing switching, customer export, interoperability and unfair contractual terms where applicable.
EU B2C/B2B digital services, Germany/Poland establishment, token and payment flows.
Source, dependencies, fonts/assets, market data, training/RAG inputs, AI output, trademarks and customer report rights.
Account eligibility, community, financial content, profiling, marketing and support.
Audit, risk, market analysis, data errors, cyber incident, outage, customer loss and contractual caps.

globalStopConditions: Any unresolved Critical or High security finding
Any missing required provider right for a delivered field
Any missing signed legal applicability decision for an enabled territory or feature
Any failed tenant isolation, refund, rollback, incident recovery or entitlement check
Any stale, partial, conflicted or fixture evidence presented as LIVE
Any paid tier without measured incremental customer value and an exact SKU decision
truthBoundary: A76 defines and validates the completion denominator and legal/regulatory review perimeter. It does not provide legal advice, decide applicability, execute exact builds, recover historical bytes, run staging, obtain provider rights, prove customer value, enable LIVE or permit sale.
